hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Let part2 be part 2 of the enemy.
If condition flag "explode_done" is up this frame, then
  Let list2 be [{abilityTag: "explode"}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: [the INSTANT_DEATH status], saChildNos: [2]}]]}}].
  Call game:ai.AiUtil.registerInterruptMultipleAbility with (part2, the id of the move labelled "explode" on part2, list2, {interruptBeforeCounter: true}).
  Part → register-interrupt-ability-by-tag with ("long_range_attack", {skipStepCnt: true}, {interruptBeforeCounter: true}).
  Part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{builtin: "CHANGE_PARAM", id: 1, paramSuffixNo: the register's 'paramSuffixNoWhenAvoid'}], [{builtin: "RESET_CAST_ABILITY", resetCAChildNos: [1]}], [{builtin: "UNSET_SA", saChildNos: [1], sa: the INVISIBLE status}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
If condition flag "shift_break_done" is up this frame, then
  Set the register's 'paramSuffixNoWhenAvoid' to the current form of part.
  Part changes to form "4".
  Part cancels its cast.
  Let v be a revive sequence {nos: [2], filteringDeformPosArray: [1, 2], deformTag: "deformation_02", shouldReset: true}.
  V → push with ([{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: the INVISIBLE status, saChildNos: [1]}], [{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: the INVINCIBLE status, saChildNos: [2]}]).
  Part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: v} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
If the current form of part is not "4", then
  Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for part under the phases list.
  If paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is not the current form of part and (part changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs, then part cancels its cast, then paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is "3"), then
    Part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_01"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
    Let v2 be the value "abilityDeformMapTag" of the enemy.
    Set v2 at 1 at (the id of the move labelled "long_range_attack" on part) to "deformation_06".
    The enemy → set with ("abilityDeformMapTag", v2).
If part is ready to act, then part picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
